name: CZ as a phase gadget
summary: A CZ gate is a π/2 phase gadget followed by −π/2 Z-phases on both qubits.
description:
The CZ gate acts as $|x_1x_2\rangle\mapsto e^{i\pi x_1x_2}|x_1x_2\rangle$. Using $x_1x_2 = \frac12(x_1 + x_2 - x_1\oplus x_2)$ and $e^{i\pi x_1x_2} = e^{-i\pi x_1x_2}$, it is the product of a two-qubit phase gadget with phase π/2, implementing $e^{i\frac\pi2(x_1\oplus x_2)}$, and Z-phases −π/2 on both qubits. Negating all phases gives the equivalent form with an S gate on both qubits and a −π/2 gadget.

In the ZX-calculus this is a consequence of the [Euler decomposition of the Hadamard](../euler-decomposition-hadamard/) on the Hadamard edge of the CZ. The same decomposition with α/2 in place of π/2 gives the controlled-phase gate.
